notes.title: Steamburg - 1.11 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today we deploy a major update for Steamburg. The improvements are listed below :

Three major improvements have been introduced in the latest version of Steamburg:

[list]
    [*]the controller can now be used - you've been requesting this option since the release of the game
    [*]a new option of bomb throwing control, as suggested by several players
    [*]achievements - easier and harder ones, about 50 of them. Whenever you are wondering why you need to do something 33 or 99 times, think about Nikola Tesla. These numbers divide by 3 and three was his favourite number.
[/list]

In addition to these, a few minor bugs reported by players have been fixed


Thank you for all your feedback. You've really helped us make Steamburg better!

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Drodzy gracze!

Jest już dostępna nowa wersja gry.

Wprowadziliśmy następujące poprawki:
- Gracze sugerowali więcej ustawień, zwłaszcza głośności muzyki. Dodaliśmy ustawienia muzyki i grafiki.
- UFO nie reaguje natychmiast na ruch Vincenta. Wydłużyliśmy czas reakcji.
- Chmury będą mniejszym utrudnieniem. 
- Naprawiliśmy drobne błędy

Dziękujemy za Wasze opinie – dzięki nim możemy poprawić grę!

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A new updated version of Steamburg is now available.

The following improvements have been introduced:

- Users asked for more settings options, especially for music volume. Both graphics and music settings have been added.

- The UFO doesn't react immediately to Vincent's moves. The response time has been extended.

- The clouds are less annoying. The level of transparency has been increased.

- Minor bugs have been fixed.

Thank you for your feedbacks!

notes.title: Update - 1.03
notes.notes:
Bonjour tout le monde !

La dernière version de Steamburg est en ligne.

Depuis la sortie du jeu, nous essayons de lire et de répondre rapidement à tous les retours des joueurs et de prendre en compte toutes les critiques. 

Suite à tout cela, voici les améliorations et corrections apportées dans cette mise à jour :

- Correction de bugs mineurs,
- Correction des polices de langues, notamment le Russe.
- Ajustements graphiques mineurs,
- Certains joueurs nous avaient informé de certains problèmes de sauvegarde au premier lancement, c'est également corrigé.


Merci pour tous vos retours ! Ensemble nous continuerons d'améliorer Steamburg :).

notes.title: Update - 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Here is the latest version of Steamburg.

Ever since the game was released, we have been trying to respond promptly to the feedback provided by gamers and reviewers.

Hence the following improvements, fixes and adjustments:

- Minor bugs have been fixed. 
- We've corrected the fonts in localizations, especially in the Russian language version.
- Minor graphic adjustments have also been made.
- Users reported a really annoying problem with saving the game at the first launch. It's also been fixed.

Thank you for reporting those issues - you are making Steamburg a better game!
